message.content: {"query_id": "T02", "candidates": [{"candidate_id": "XW", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4401415993", "quote": "We introduce ChatChisel, the first language-based agile hardware design workflow that generates Chisel from language specifications. ChatChisel utilizes four LLM-based modules for decomposing, generating, error-correcting, and composing hardware designs.", "statement": "该论文提出ChatChisel，一个基于语言的敏捷硬件设计工作流，利用四个基于LLM的模块进行硬件设计的分解、生成、纠错与组合。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4416429577", "quote": "MMCircuitEval comprises 3614 meticulously curated question-answer (QA) pairs spanning digital and analog circuits across critical EDA stages—ranging from general knowledge and specifications to front-end and back-end design.", "statement": "该论文构建的MMCircuitEval基准包含3614个问答对，覆盖数字与模拟电路从前端到后端设计等关键EDA阶段。"}], "rationale": "若需将领域语言模型用于芯片设计，该候选人的LLM硬件生成工作流与覆盖前后端设计的评测基准，或可提供任务分解与评测思路；但均未涉及时序、物理设计或可执行设计流程验证。", "unknowns": "需了解其是否具备时序/物理设计任务知识、可用的真实设计数据与工艺库授权，以及能否参与可执行设计流程验证。"}, {"candidate_id": "WWSH", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4413120686", "quote": "This paper introduces LLMACD, a knowledge-embedded automation designer for analog circuit design based on large language models (LLMs). We design a refined prompt manager to extract circuit representation, embed circuit knowledge, and model the knowledge-intensive design process within a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) workflow.", "statement": "该论文提出LLMACD，一个基于大语言模型的模拟电路设计知识嵌入式自动化设计器，并设计了精炼的提示管理器以提取电路表示、嵌入电路知识并在思维链工作流中建模设计过程。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4389776171", "quote": "The PVT-Transfer Framework is evaluated on three integrated voltage references and compared with four state-of-the-art circuit sizing methods. Based on post-layout Monte-Carlo simulations, this framework is verified to offer superior performance to existing methods", "statement": "该论文的PVT-Transfer框架在三个集成电压基准上评估，并与四种先进电路尺寸优化方法比较，基于版图后蒙特卡洛仿真验证其性能优于现有方法。"}], "rationale": "若需将领域语言模型用于芯片设计，该候选人的LLM模拟电路设计流程与版图后仿真验证经验，或可补充设计任务知识与流程验证视角；但均针对模拟电路，未涉及时序或物理设计布局。", "unknowns": "需了解其是否掌握数字时序/物理设计任务、能否提供可授权真实设计数据，以及是否愿意参与可执行设计流程验证。"}, {"candidate_id": "JY", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4402940010", "quote": "Pivotal to this vision is the development of a multimodal circuit representation learning technique, poised to provide a comprehensive understanding by harmonizing and extracting insights from varied data sources, such as functional specifications, register-transfer level (RTL) designs, circuit netlists, and physical layouts.", "statement": "该论文主张发展多模态电路表示学习技术，通过协调和提取功能规格、RTL设计、电路网表与物理版图等多种数据源的洞见来提供全面理解。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4413122606", "quote": "ForgeEDA includes diverse circuit representations such as Register Transfer Level (RTL) code, Post-mapping (PM) netlists, And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs), and placed netlists, enabling comprehensive analysis and development.", "statement": "该论文提出的ForgeEDA数据集包含RTL代码、映射后网表、与逆变器图和布局后网表等多种电路表示。"}], "rationale": "若需将领域语言模型用于芯片设计，该候选人的多模态电路表示学习主张与含布局后网表的开放数据集，或可提供数据表示与布局相关任务线索；但论文为综述与数据集构建，未验证可执行设计流程。", "unknowns": "需了解其是否具备时序/物理设计任务知识、数据集许可与真实设计数据可用性，以及能否参与可执行设计流程验证。"}], "exclusions": []}
